name: OpenAI Agents SDK
summary: The OpenAI Agents SDK is a lightweight framework for multi-agent workflows in Python, with a separate JavaScript/TypeScript version. Agents are LLMs with instructions, tools, guardrails and handoffs; the SDK adds sessions, tracing, human-in-the-loop and, since April 2026, sandbox agents that work in containers over long tasks. It supports the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs plus other LLMs.
facts: Sandbox agents: local Unix, Docker or hosted clients (E2B, Modal, Daytona, Vercel and others)
goodFor: Long-running coding or file tasks in sandboxes
watchOut: Python and JS/TS SDKs are separate projects
